description:
02:32 Over and over again, Ellen White says that marriage and the Sabbath are twin institutions. So my question is: Is it a must to marry? Because when someone reaches marriage age and chooses not to marry—yet keeps the Sabbath—it seems like that person is degrading the twin institution to the Sabbath, which is marriage.
15:45  My question is about Zechariah 4:14 and Revelation 11:4. Who are the “anointed ones” mentioned here? Are both passages talking about the same thing, or is one referring to angels and the other to the Bible?

chapters.title: Over and over again, Ellen White says that marriage and the Sabbath are twin institutions. So my question is: Is it a must to marry? My question is about Zechariah 4:14 and Revelation 11:4. Who are the “anointed ones” mentioned here? Are both passages talking about the same thing, or is one referring to angels and the other to the Bible?
